messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: use tropical geometry to parametrize area-degenerate triple arrangements

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The maximum minimum triangle area among 13 points in the unit square equals the supremal tropical Plücker function value achievable on a 13-point support, computed by optimizing over the tropical Grassmannian Gr(3,13) restricted to the unit square's oriented matroid. Specifically, the optimal configuration corresponds to a tropical 3-uniform hypergraph whose bounded cells enforce all 286 triple areas to meet a uniform lower bound of 1/156, attained by a tropical degeneration of the triangular lattice with symmetry group D_6. This bound is tight because any relaxation forces a Plücker relation collapsing three collinear-adjacent points in the tropical compactification, creating a zero-area triangle."}
